title: Temporal staleness
headline: 0.0% of NPD resources carry a meta.lastUpdated value on the release day (2026-08-20). Distinct meta.lastUpdated values range from 1 to 8 across the 6 resource types — meta.lastUpdated on the NPD bulk public-use files is a bulk-export stamp, not a per-resource freshness signal.
notes: Per-resource distinct meta.lastUpdated values on release day 2026-08-20: practitioner → 1 distinct, 100.00% at modal; organization → 8 distinct, 50.02% at modal; location → 1 distinct, 100.00% at modal; endpoint → 1 distinct, 100.00% at modal; practitioner_role → 2 distinct, 97.61% at modal; organization_affiliation → 2 distinct, 96.38% at modal. Regulatory compliance with the 30-day CMS-9115-F or 90-day REAL Health Providers Act / No Surprises Act update cadence CANNOT be measured from meta.lastUpdated on the bulk files — a per-record freshness signal from upstream NPPES (enumeration_date / last_updated) or PECOS would be required.
